snippet.title: Echoes of Mora - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Dive into the mysteries of a sunken Italian village in Echoes of Mora, a cozy narrative adventure about family, loss and long-forgotten secrets.

Explore the village beneath the lake, search for clues and solve environmental puzzles as you uncover what happened before the flood. Unlock mysterious Echoes to travel through time, experience the village before the tragedy and interact with Mora as she searches for her missing brother Dario.

Your interactions and subtle decisions can influence Mora's journey, while a seamless switch between traditional PC and VR gameplay lets you experience the mystery your way.

Wishlist Echoes of Mora now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129050/Echoes_of_Mora/

Coming to PC and PC VR in Q3 2026.
